cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(traj_opt)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED)
find_package(PCL REQUIRED COMPONENTS common)
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(sensor_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(nav_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(visualization_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(cv_bridge REQUIRED)
find_package(pcl_conversions REQUIRED)
find_package(ego_ros2 REQUIRED)
find_package(plan_env REQUIRED)
find_package(path_searching REQUIRED)
find_package(traj_utils REQUIRED)
add_library(traj_opt_lib SHARED src/poly_traj_optimizer.cpp)
target_include_directories(traj_opt_lib PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include> ${PCL_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(traj_opt_lib Eigen3::Eigen ${PCL_LIBRARIES} ${OpenCV_LIBRARIES})
ament_target_dependencies(traj_opt_lib rclcpp std_msgs sensor_msgs geometry_msgs nav_msgs visualization_msgs cv_bridge pcl_conversions ego_ros2 plan_env path_searching traj_utils)
install(TARGETS traj_opt_lib DESTINATION lib)
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION include)
ament_export_libraries(traj_opt_lib)
ament_export_include_directories(include)
ament_export_dependencies(rclcpp std_msgs sensor_msgs geometry_msgs nav_msgs visualization_msgs cv_bridge pcl_conversions ego_ros2 plan_env path_searching traj_utils)
ament_package()
